description: Hand-labelled ground-truth adjacency and illustrative transit-time distributions for the demo ring topology (configs/nodes/local: node-00..node-03 each gossip to their 2 ring neighbours). Consumed by scripts/evaluate_topology.py (WP-07, C6). The mean_transit_s/sigma_log values are synthetic priors for the offline evaluation harness, not measured from real camera footage -- this repo has no real multi-camera video yet (the same 'needs actual video' follow-up already noted in docs/results_c1.md and docs/results_c4.md).
